hypothesis: When Binance spot and perpetual move together without changing their basis, Deribit BTC-PERPETUAL and the Deribit BTCUSD index distinguish a broad BTC move from a Binance-common-mode move. If Polymarket follows the latter while the full received Deribit benchmark path stays quiet, buy the directly quoted opposite token only when the pre-impact complementary fair value leaves at least three cents after fee.

signal.exact_us015_exclusion: run the frozen US-015 detector independently per market on the same receipt-ordered tape and permanently reject a market as soon as its PM-book-anchored immutable wedge candidate is captured, before waiting for later source confirmation or signal emission
signal.quiet_benchmark_path: every received Deribit quote and index frame after the crossing through the decision must remain within the frozen absolute threshold; a later quiet frame cannot erase an earlier confirmation
signal.decision_time: the first local receipt when the immutable common-mode crossing, at least one strictly post-crossing Deribit quote and index frame, and a qualifying already-received direct Polymarket book are all known
signal.fair: one minus the direct direction-side midpoint observed before the immutable Binance crossing

causality.total_order: stable within-transport input order; exact equal receipt timestamps across transports or between source and CLOB are censored, and scheduled evaluations precede market data with an exactly equal receipt timestamp
causality.clob_application_order: apply snapshots and deltas strictly in local receipt order including later-received removals; exchange timestamps never suppress a received removal or preserve an older displayed ask
causality.spot_bbo_lifecycle: the raw bn_spot bookTicker sidecar has its own connection epoch; its disconnect fails closed independently of the strict spot-trade transport
causality.disconnect: any normalized source or CLOB disconnect clears all live quotes, books and pending crossings; the consumed first-attempt identity remains consumed
causality.regressed_receipt_time: clear all live state, reject the regressed frame and retain the prior receipt high-water mark

execution.limit: highest direct ask required to fill five shares at the frozen decision, unchanged afterward
execution.partial_fills: record every positive FAK fill and PnL; only full five-share fills enter stopping
execution.fee_rounding: total USDC fee rounded to five decimals using half-up

controls.benchmark_confirmation: disjoint negative-control cohort: a separate immutable crossing with the same Binance common move and Polymarket follow, but the latest received Deribit quote and index both move more than 0.5 bp in the Binance direction; never reported as a matched arm
controls.no_polymarket_follow: disjoint negative-control cohort: a separate immutable quiet-benchmark crossing whose first admissible direction-side Polymarket move is greater than zero but no more than 0.5 cents; crossing above 0.5 cents permanently rejects the market and the cohort is never reported as a matched arm
controls.direction_reversal: matched base arm: at the identical base decision buy the directly quoted Binance-follow side instead of the frozen opposite side and retain the base parent signal id
controls.time_shift: matched base arm: delay the frozen base side, fair and limit exactly 5000 ms, require five direct shares still executable and retain the base parent signal id
controls.basis_wedge_comparator: the independent per-market US-015 state machine is an admission exclusion because source-window basis coordinates alone do not guarantee disjointness when PM-book and source anchors differ

statistics.stopping_clock: earliest common decision receipt timestamp at which both base latency arms have 1000 resolved full five-share fills across at least seven UTC days

promotion.next_required_work: accumulate the untouched post-2026-10-11 checksum-bound paper sample until the frozen common stopping rule is reached
